summary: A bounded Georgia recipient-record recovery found 13 strict GEO corporate rows totaling $31,000 across 2024-2025 and two PAC-labelled/business-class ambiguity rows totaling $2,500 that were excluded from the strict corporate aggregate.
detail: The archived official PeachFile results contain one strict 2024 row for $5,000 and 12 strict 2025 rows totaling $26,000. GEO reported Georgia Corporate totals of $77,500 and $64,800, leaving company-minus-primary coverage differences of $72,500 and $38,800. Those are partial-coverage differences, not reporting-error findings. The two 2025 payer strings containing PAC were preserved but excluded even though PeachFile classified them as Corporation / Business / Unregistered Committee.
